cmd.help_text:
gil — open one step of thinking, do it for real, write it down and close it.

Every day
  gil start   start the project and open the first Interview
  gil open    open the next step — **saying what you intend to do** (stdin)
  gil close   after the actual work, write the Report and close that step (stdin)

An action step opens with an action contract. GIL never invents its content.

  gil open <<'EOF'
  objective:   what you want to achieve
  next_action: the first thing to do in the real world now (not a gil command)
  done_when:   what you must see to call it done
  EOF

A Cycle is a container, so it opens without a contract — `gil open <kind>`.

One round
  start → open → actual work → close → open → …
  gil judges the boundary between Step and Cycle. You need not memorize which layer you are in.

To see the contract of the current position — **read only, nothing changes.**
  gil open --help    what can open now and the shape of the action contract
  gil close --help   the fields needed to close the current position and what their values mean

When taking over
  gil context   restore the current position in a new session, a handoff or after losing context
  gil status    say where we are in three lines
  gil story     read what has been walked in plain words
  gil monitor   read the current state and its grounds on one screen
  gil monitor --html   the same as one HTML document you can save and open
  gil monitor --serve   keep watching in a browser (Ctrl-C ends it)

When Artifacts were changed and you want them back — **takes no arguments.**
  gil restore   return the working folder to the world the current position requires

How a Report is written — the characters you write are the value. No comments, no quoting, no type conversion.

  gil close <<'EOF'
  problem: to the end of the line as is — #7 and 3.10 are just characters
  next_direction:
    action: close_cycle          (indentation joins names with a dot)
  interpretation: |
    several lines open like this.
  EOF

When closing a Cycle, the field that points at the verdict is an **address** — not the screen's `#4` but:

  outcome_ref: step:C1/S4

`gil open` and `gil close` tell you what to write, right there.

Old names (compatibility)
  gil cycle open · gil cycle close   `gil open` · `gil close` now judge both layers
  gil revisit                        step the revisit already written in a closed verdict
  gil --version                      print the version

Install (Windows)
  gil install    register this executable with Claude Desktop and Codex
  gil doctor     report the registration state, one line per Host (OK · NOT_INSTALLED · MISSING · STALE · ERROR)
  gil uninstall  remove only the gil entry from both settings files
  gil serve      same as `gil mcp --serve`

ctx.plan.synthesis_closed: The approved Synthesis is closed. Open the Interview Outcome with gil_open(kind: outcome). Do not ask for approval again or repeat gil_plan_propose.
ctx.plan.synthesis_propose: Open Synthesis (approved-plan profile): propose with gil_plan_propose({project_root, draft:{scope, items, synthesis}}) — the five draft.scope fields (goal · in_scope · out_of_scope · constraints · success_criteria), draft.items (id · question · done_when), the draft.synthesis Report fields. draft.synthesis.exploration_checklist is a string listing the item ids in the same order, one per line. A Closing keeps the existing items and adds draft.synthesis.chain_verdict (success or failure). Do not write approved, plan_revision or plan_digest. Chat consent is no substitute.
ctx.plan.verify_doc: Open Verify (approved-plan profile): save gil_plan_read.document byte-for-byte to a file and write its relative path in the Report's plan_document. Save the observed results of the actual work as separate files and list them in evidence_files. The plan document alone does not close it.
ctx.plan.waiting: Proposal revision {revision} awaits the Monitor button response. End the turn and wait. Do not change project files or re-propose meanwhile. Check for a response only with gil_plan_read.
ctx.plan_label_closed: Execution binding of the closed Experiment
ctx.plan_profile: Approved-plan profile: open the Synthesis, gil_plan_propose({project_root, draft:{scope, items, synthesis}}) → Monitor button response → close with gil_plan_read's close_report → Outcome → close the Interview Cycle. Chat consent is no substitute.
ctx.plan_proposal: Proposal revision {revision} · response {receipt}. Read the exact result with gil_plan_read.
ctx.plan_reinterview_closed: The current Cycle is closed. Get a new approval with gil_open(kind: interview). Do not cancel the request automatically or skip to a new Experiment.
ctx.plan_reinterview_open: The request is preserved until this Cycle ends. Finish the current Cycle's remaining Steps in their actual order and close the Cycle Report before opening the Interview. Do not cancel the request automatically, skip Steps or open another Cycle at the same time.
ctx.plan_state:
Approved revision: {revision} · unexecuted order: {pending}
Execution bindings: {executed}
ctx.plan_verify_doc: In the open Verify, save gil_plan_read.document to a file and write its path in plan_document. Also leave separate evidence of the actual work in evidence_files.
ctx.position_none: Position: nothing opened in this Cycle yet
ctx.preamble:
GIL context — what you need to know to continue walking from the current position.

Distance sets the resolution: past Cycles down to the projection that represents each, the current Cycle
down to Step Reports, the current position down to its rules. The Step Graphs of past Cycles are only
folded here; they are not gone and remain preserved in the original Graph.
ctx.previous_head:
═══ Previous Cycles ═══
({n} · only the ancestors leading to this position · one Cycle-resolution projection per ancestor)
Sources read — purpose and success criterion: that Cycle's only Define · lesson of the verdict:
the Outcome its outcome_ref points to · the rest: that Cycle's Report.
The Step Graph inside is not unfolded — the attempts and turns remain in the original Graph.
ctx.reinterview_notice: A re-interview request is preserved: after this Cycle closes, open an Interview and get approval again. Until then the request stays as it is; do not skip the current Step or rush the Cycle closed with invented evidence.
ctx.report_principles:
[Principles for writing a Report]  (GIL Specification v0.1 “Report writing invariants”)
Write so that a collaborator who took no part in this Node can point to the same subject and grounds alone.
Do not state a subject or conclusion with only undefined abbreviations, internal step codes or issue numbers.
Do not mix observation (verify) with interpretation (analysis); write success and failure claims so they
can be traced to the pre-set criteria and to Report/Artifact evidence.

ctx.will_none: No action is pending — what to do next is written at `gil open`.
cycle.already_closed: This Cycle is already closed — nothing moves inside a closed Cycle

cycle.basis.not_found: {target}, pointed at by {field}, is not in this Cycle
cycle.basis.not_in_lineage: {target} is not on the path {here} walked — the basis must be inside this proposal's Lineage (parent chain). A position reached only through an abandoned branch or a revisit is no basis, however small its name
cycle.basis.other_cycle: {field} points at {target}, which is in another Cycle — the basis must be inside this Interview ({cycle})
cycle.basis.still_open: {target} is still open — {here} takes only an already closed question or interpretation as a basis
cycle.basis.unreadable: {value} in {field} does not read as a Step address — {source}. Write the real closed references of the current {cycle}, one per line
cycle.basis.wrong_kind: {target} is a {kind} and cannot be a basis — {field} points at an already closed question or interpretation
cycle.basis_refs_rules: basis_refs lists, one per line (step:Cn/Sm), at least one closed Question or Interpretation Step reference from the parent chain that leads to this Synthesis within the current Interview Cycle, without duplicates. Comma lists, prose, Cycle references, Steps of other Cycles and abandoned branches are not allowed. Background from earlier Cycles or outside material is explained in statement and does not replace basis_refs. References are never moved or fixed automatically.
cycle.closing_interview: Closing a Chain needs the approved Synthesis pointed at by the last Outcome of a successful Interview, and chain_verdict: success or failure. The Cycle Report carrying this closing proposal must have the direction close_chain

Write here: {field}: {expected}
cycle.outcome.not_last:

Basing it on an earlier verdict makes the Cycle Report say something other than its own record.
cycle.outcome.not_outcome:

cycle.outcome.other_cycle:

cycle.outcome.unreadable:

cycle.outcome.verdict_disagrees: The Cycle says {cycle} while {target} says {outcome} — the two verdicts differ in layer but must have the same value
cycle.steps_not_done: This Cycle cannot close yet — the Outcome inside must be closed
cycle.synth.not_approved: That Synthesis has {field} = {approved} — only a proposal a human approved with {yes} becomes the Interview's basis
cycle.synth.not_in_lineage: {target} is not on the path {here} walked — success closes only with an approved Synthesis inside this Outcome's Lineage (parent chain)
cycle.synth.not_synthesis: {target} has no closed Synthesis — {field} must point at an approved proposal
cycle.synth.other_cycle: {field} points at {target}, but this is {here} — the basis must be inside this Interview
cycle.synth.unreadable: {value} in {field} does not read as a Step address — {source}
cycle.synth.wrong_branch:
That Synthesis has {field} = {approved}, so the next is {wanted} — {asked} is not this branch.

cycles.parent_cycle: The parent chain is longer than the number of Cycles — this Cycle Graph has a cycle

evidence.empty_file: An empty file is not evidence: {path}
evidence.field_required: Write the actual execution and observed result in {field}
evidence.files_required: A Verify cannot close on chat and the Report body alone. Save the observation document, execution results and visuals as actual files and list their relative paths in evidence_files
evidence.lesson_required: Write the interpretation and lesson drawn from the observation in {text}. Growth is not recorded with empty content
evidence.no_basis_step: The current lineage has no closed basis step

evidence.not_in_snapshot: The evidence file is not in the Snapshot to confirm: {path}

guide.closed.blocked: Next action: nothing can be done here. Read gil_status once and tell the user why it is blocked.
guide.closed.chain_report: Next action: submit the Chain Report with gil_close. Do not open a new Cycle.
guide.closed.close_cycle: Next action: submit this Cycle's Report with gil_close. Do not use gil_cycle(action=close).
guide.closed.experiment_open_cycle: Next action: the Experiment Cycle is closed. If an independent question remains, gil_open(kind: experiment); if the goal must be agreed again, gil_open(kind: interview). Even when all work is done, do not end with a chat report alone: if there is a Chain, open the Closing Interview with gil_open(kind: interview), get the final verdict approved and close the Chain Report.
guide.closed.experiment_revisit_dev: Next action: this Cycle closed as failure · revisit. An Artifact restore follows, so tell the user, call gil_revisit (no arguments) once, and then open a new Cycle with gil_open.
guide.closed.experiment_revisit_product: Next action: this Cycle closed as failure · revisit. Open the Monitor, guide the user to review the change list and the preserved location, then wait for the ‘Preserve and revisit’ button. Do not transcribe chat consent as approval or repeat gil_revisit. After the restore completes, open a new Cycle with gil_open. The failure record, evidence and lessons remain.
guide.closed.generic: GIL progress: this close succeeded. Before further work, follow the next action in the receipt below. If a Hypothesis was closed, the next action is gil_open for Verify. Do not change project files before the open is confirmed. If this was a typed close without next guidance, read gil_status once. Do not perform an unrecorded next step first.
guide.closed.hypothesis: Next action: open the Verify with gil_open(kind: verify) and an action contract. Do not change project files before the open succeeds.
guide.closed.interview_open_cycle: Next action: the Interview Cycle is closed too. Open the Experiment for the first agreed question with gil_open(kind: experiment). In the approved-plan profile the first unexecuted item is bound automatically. Do not call gil_start again.
guide.closed.interview_outcome_cycle: Next action: submit the Interview Cycle Report with gil_close (verdict · outcome_ref · handoff_summary · next_direction). Open the Experiment after that succeeds, and change project files in Verify.
guide.closed.open_kind: Next action: open gil_open(kind: {k}) with an action contract. Do not change project files before a Verify is actually open.
guide.closed.open_many: Next action: open one of the following with gil_open: {kinds}. The receipt below says how to choose.
guide.closed.outcome_cycle: Next action: submit this Cycle's Report with gil_close. If the Verify attached visuals, the Cycle Report also cites them with expected_owner {kind: cycle} and visuals.uses (stored source). Open the next problem after that.
guide.closed.synthesis_outcome: Next action: open the Interview Outcome with gil_open(kind: outcome). Do not ask for approval again or reopen the Synthesis. After closing the Outcome, close the Interview Cycle Report separately as well.
guide.closed.synthesis_question: Next action: not approved. Ask what must change with gil_open(kind: question). The approval of an earlier proposal is not reused.
guide.closed.verify: Next action: open the place to interpret the saved evidence with gil_open(kind: analysis). Do not change project files. If this Verify attached visuals, cite them (owner · asset_id · sha256) as a stored source when closing the Analysis and the Cycle Report.
guide.context: GIL resume: when continuing this project, follow the one line under {heading} in the context below first. Do not demand GIL steps to answer an unrelated topic. If the completion condition is met, gil_close comes before more work. Do not repeat an already closed step and do not call gil_start again on an existing project. Change project files only in an open Verify.
guide.dirty_close.dev: If the refusal is dirty: tell the user the change list from the refusal, and if the user chooses to roll back, send the same gil_close after gil_restore. Deliverables made outside a Verify are recreated in the next Experiment's Verify.
guide.dirty_close.product: If the refusal is dirty: this build refuses Artifact rollback (restore). Read the change list in the refusal; move new files to a new preserved location outside the project (to keep their content, close the current position, then recreate them in the next Experiment's Verify and list them in evidence_files), preserve the current content of changed existing files separately and restore them to the baseline content, then send the same gil_close.
guide.file_boundary: Create, modify, delete, move or import project files only in a Verify that is actually open. This includes producing and rendering DOCX, PNG and PDF files. Work outside the project and web research that leaves no project file are not covered by this limit. This is Agent guidance for the selected GIL project, not an OS write block. GIL installs no hooks and this does not apply to ordinary shells or other projects.
guide.opened.analysis: GIL progress: an Analysis is open. Interpret only the saved Verify evidence and gil_close with a non-blank interpretation. Do not change project files. If the Verify attached visuals, this close must cite them: send expected_owner and visuals together, and in uses write the Verify receipt's owner, asset_id and sha256 as a stored source (attachments is an empty array, declaration omitted).
guide.opened.define: GIL progress: a Define is open. Write only the one question to check and its judgment criterion, then gil_close. Project files change in Verify.
guide.opened.experiment: GIL progress: an Experiment Cycle is open. The next call is gil_open(kind: define) with an action contract. Handle one question only, and do not change project files before a Verify is actually open.
guide.opened.generic: GIL progress: do only the 'To do now' below. When the completion condition is met, gil_close with the observed result and move to the next action. Do not keep attaching work with another purpose to this node. An Interview goes only as far as agreeing on the goal. Change project files only in an Experiment Verify that is actually open. Work outside the project and web research that leaves no file are not limited to GIL steps.
guide.opened.hypothesis: GIL progress: a Hypothesis is open. Write the expectation, its basis and the guardrail, then gil_close. After it closes, the next call is gil_open for Verify; do not change project files before that succeeds.
guide.opened.interpretation: GIL progress: an Interpretation is open. Separate what the answer settled from what remains unknown and gil_close. Do not change project files.
guide.opened.interview: GIL progress: an Interview Cycle is open. The next call is gil_open(kind: question) with an action contract. Project files are not changed in an Interview.
guide.opened.interview_outcome: GIL progress: an Interview Outcome is open. Judge the approved scope and gil_close. Do not leave it open until the project ends. After closing it, gil_close the Interview Cycle Report separately.
guide.opened.outcome: GIL progress: an Experiment Outcome is open. gil_close with a verdict, lesson and next_direction grounded in the actual Analysis. After closing it, gil_close the Cycle Report separately.
guide.opened.question: GIL progress: a Question is open. Ask the user and wait for the answer. gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn. When the answer arrives, gil_close with its original text. Do not close by writing the user's original request as the response — never close without an actual answer. Do not change project files while waiting. File-free web research, reading existing evidence and unrelated outside work are allowed and do not stand in for the user's answer.
guide.opened.synthesis: GIL progress: a Synthesis is open. Show the proposal statement to the user (in the approved-plan profile, propose first with gil_plan_propose({project_root, draft:{scope, items, synthesis}}) and wait for the Monitor button — scope, items and synthesis go inside draft, and exploration_checklist is a string inside synthesis. A Closing keeps the existing items and adds draft.synthesis.chain_verdict (success or failure)). Wait for the answer. gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn. gil_close only with explicit consent. Silence, an earlier request or your own judgment is not approval. Do not change project files while waiting.
guide.opened.synthesis_basis:
{specific}
Proposal input $.draft.synthesis.basis_refs: {location}{rules} In a JSON string a line break is written as \n. Shape example (replace S1/S2 with the real closed references): {example}
guide.opened.synthesis_location: Current Synthesis: {here}, Interview: {cycle}. Check the real closed references with gil_context.
guide.opened.verify: GIL progress: a Verify is open. Now actually perform the contract's next_action. Save the observed results as project files and gil_close including evidence_files. Chat alone does not close it. Leave visual evidence too: plots drawn by code for data, diagrams for structure, real-browser (headless is fine) screenshots for UI/web, comparison tables saved as PNG for file changes, attached through visuals.attachments/uses with declaration attached (AI-generated images are not visual evidence). If no image is truly needed, state concretely in not_needed what replaces it — a one-word reason is refused. In the approved-plan profile, leave both the plan_document file and separate execution evidence.
guide.plan.approved: Approved plan: revision {revision} was approved. The next call is gil_close (Synthesis) with close_report inserted verbatim. Only after closing in the order gil_open(kind: outcome) → gil_close → gil_close of the Interview Cycle Report do you open gil_open(kind: experiment).
guide.plan.bound: Approved plan: this Experiment is bound to item {item}. In Verify, save document byte-for-byte to a file and name it in plan_document; record the actual work evidence as separate files in evidence_files.
guide.plan.changes: Approved plan: changes were requested for revision {revision}. gil_close the Synthesis with close_report (approved: no) and ask what to change in the next Question. A revised proposal is a new revision; the earlier approval is not reused.
guide.plan.cycle_closed: Approved plan: the current Cycle is already closed. The item binding remains as a record. The next call is gil_context. Follow the next action in its reply to continue with a new Cycle or the Chain Report. Do not keep changing project files in a closed Step.
guide.plan.cycle_unknown: Approved plan: the item binding alone cannot confirm that the current Cycle is open. The next call is gil_context. Confirm the actually open Step and the next action, then continue.
guide.plan.none: Approved plan: neither an open proposal nor an unexecuted item. In an open Synthesis, propose with gil_plan_propose. If every item was executed, open the Closing Interview with gil_open(kind: interview), get the final verdict (chain_verdict) approved and close the Chain Report. Do not end with a chat report alone, and do not invent approval.
guide.plan.pending: Approved plan: no proposal is open. Unexecuted items: {pending}. If the Interview is closed, open the first unexecuted item with gil_open(kind: experiment). If a Synthesis is open, propose with gil_plan_propose first.
guide.plan.reinterview: Approved plan: a re-interview request is preserved. Finish the current Cycle's remaining Steps in receipt order, close the Cycle Report, then get approval again with gil_open(kind: interview). No Experiment can open before then. If a Step is open, closing that Step is the next call.
guide.plan.request_interview: Approved plan: the re-interview request was preserved. Nothing was closed or opened. Continue the currently open Step as the last receipt's next action says; after the remaining Steps and the Cycle Report close in their actual order, get approval again with gil_open(kind: interview). The request is preserved meanwhile, and no new Experiment can open before then. There is no call that cancels the request or aborts the Cycle.
guide.plan.unsupported: Approved plan: this project is not in the approved-plan profile. Do not demand gil_plan_*. Wait for the user's answer in an ordinary Synthesis. gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn.
guide.plan.waiting: Approved plan: proposal revision {revision} was recorded and awaits the Monitor button response. End the turn and wait. gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn. Do not substitute chat consent or write approved yourself. Do not change project files or re-propose meanwhile. Check for a response only with gil_plan_read.
guide.refused.close: GIL refusal: nothing was closed. Fix the input error named in the reason below and send the same gil_close once more. If the position is uncertain, read gil_status first. Do not skip other steps or backfill records in bulk.
guide.refused.open: GIL refusal: nothing was opened. Read the reason below and send once more with a kind allowed at the current position and an action contract (objective · next_action · done_when). If the position is uncertain, read gil_status.
guide.refused.plan_propose: The proposal was not recorded. Fix the specific cause above. Copy all existing items from gil_plan_read.active_plan.items as they are and add new IDs. Read the connected gil_plan_propose schema for the input shape.
guide.refused.plan_read: GIL refusal: the approval state could not be read. If the reply is uncertain, read gil_plan_read once more. Do not invent an approval or close the Synthesis.
guide.refused.plan_request_interview: GIL refusal: the re-interview request was not recorded. Send it once more from the open Experiment with a reason of 1–4096 bytes. The next call for the current Step is unchanged — continue with the next action of the last receipt.
guide.refused.revisit: GIL refusal: no revisit happened. If the reason is a dirty world, an approved-plan binding or no recorded direction, tell the user that condition. Do not repeat gil_revisit or run restore automatically.
guide.refused.start: GIL refusal: no new project was created. If a project already exists, read gil_context once and continue from the recorded position. Do not repeat gil_start.
guide.revisit: GIL revisit complete: the working folder was restored to the target Cycle's world. The next call opens a new Cycle with gil_open(kind: interview|experiment). Do not repeat gil_revisit.
guide.show_monitor: GIL progress: the Monitor display was requested. In a fresh-start flow, call gil_open(kind: question) with the same project_root first and ask. Even without a goal yet, open the Question with an action contract that asks for the goal and the completion criterion. Ask in the new Question and wait for the user's answer (gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn) — do not write the user's request down as the answer and move on. On an existing project, continue the currently open step. Whether the screen is actually visible is not confirmed yet.
guide.start: GIL start: this folder is now a GIL project. Before answering in the chat, make the show_gil_monitor call written in the receipt below first, with the scope_id exactly as given. Then open gil_open(kind: question), ask for the goal and wait for the actual answer. gil_await_user(project_root, question) is an optional read-only check, not a condition for ending the turn. Change project files and produce reports only in an open Experiment Verify. File-free web research, reading existing evidence and unrelated outside work are allowed but do not replace GIL completion.
guide.status: GIL position: the one line below starting with 'Next:' is the move available now. Do not call status repeatedly in the same session; make that move.

mcp.show_monitor: GIL Monitor data is prepared. {next}
A new Interview proposal copies all of active_plan.items verbatim (executed items included) and adds new IDs. Order and scope may change with a new approval, but an existing item's question/done_when cannot. active_plan is the executable approved revision and is null until one exists. document is the UTF-8 original of the approved revision bound when the Experiment opened. It is null before binding, and neither a read nor a failed close creates it. If the current Experiment has a binding but document is null, do not write a summary instead; check the current connection and state. Save files only in a Verify that is actually open. One Experiment is bound to exactly one current_item. executed_cycles is an open binding; the proof of success is that Cycle Report.
